title: PR #223: Competitive monitoring baseline and snapshots (2026-10-19–2026-10-22) — conventional history
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

## Purpose

Replacement draft for [PR #214](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/pull/214), created to address the V-16 Conventional Commits gate without rewriting or force-pushing the original PR branch.

## Change and history handling

- Preserves the existing registry, report, resolver, tests, and validation workflow tree from original head `3d09b21baab8cc0508027b1d465e71698bcbf3a8`.
- Uses one Conventional Commit on the original PR's merge-base `c675d7d9e22f14bb10965383224201d16bfa1cc0`: `chore(competitive-monitoring): add reproducible registry validation and snapshots`.
- The original PR branch and its history are untouched.
- Compared against `main`, the replacement branch changes only the same 13 intended competitive-monitoring files; no generated KMS-record drift is included.
- Governance V-16 was rerun on the exact replacement head via push event; see the verified result below.

## Existing registry evidence (historical, not yet revalidated on this head)

On original PR head `3d09b21baab8cc0508027b1d465e71698bcbf3a8`, dedicated Registry Validation run [#39825879674](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/actions/runs/39825879674) passed: 12 unit/negative tests, deterministic resolution matched byte-for-byte, and the registry validator passed. Artifact ZIP SHA-256: `88bef2cb020f1612d8b43c0a16d533de7c8f86a4540055eb3a65c51cf79ddd3d`.

The full Governance run [#39825879791](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/actions/runs/39825879791) failed on that original head at V-16 (10% Conventional Commits vs required 80%). That result is not represented as a pass for this replacement branch; the new exact-head run is required.

## Remaining acceptance items

- Confirm V-16 and all required checks on the exact replacement head.
- Re-review inherited vendor claims at source level.
- Demonstrate actual daily scheduled operation separately; a workflow definition or pull-request run does not prove scheduled production operation.

Keep this PR Draft and unmerged until the exact-head governance and all other acceptance requirements are verified.

Head: `31d856f7660161da1ea02155f715b23160f58109`.

- Repository Governance push run [#39827510330](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/actions/runs/39827510330): **PASS** on ref `chore/competitor-radar-2026-10-22-conventional-history` and exact head `31d856f7660161da1ea02155f715b23160f58109`.
- Audit log: `V-16 (CI/CD): Conventional Commits: 100% der letzten 16`; score `97/100`, `MUST-FAILs: 0`, `GATE: PASS`.
- Dedicated Registry Validation push run [#39827510398](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/actions/runs/39827510398): **PASS** on the same exact head.
- Evidence artifact ID `12447216775`; ZIP SHA-256 `a779269e566d8be1f372908c2309fe78f77498423909c0c0e1b674d7c8b1dcc0`.

The pull-request-triggered suite was still queued/in progress at the last check-run snapshot; its completion must be confirmed separately. These push results establish the V-16 and registry push gates, not final PR acceptance. Keep this PR Draft and unmerged while the remaining checks and claim-level/daily-scheduler evidence are reviewed.
